name: OCEANIC-STROKE
teachingPoint: Positive ischemic efficacy result in the selected trial population. Clinical use depends on regulatory authorization and current guidance; do not describe major bleeding as proven unchanged.

name: OCEANIC-AF
fullName: Asundexian versus Apixaban in Patients with Atrial Fibrillation
population: n=14810, mean 73.9 ± 7.7; 35.2% women, NIHSS mean CHA₂DS₂-VASc 4.3 ± 1.3; 18.2% prior stroke or TIA, stopped prematurely on DMC recommendation
finding: Asundexian markedly WORSE: 1.3% (98 patients) vs 0.4% (26 patients)
teachingPoint: Asundexian is inferior to apixaban for AF stroke prevention (HR 3.79) despite less bleeding — do not substitute it for a DOAC.

name: AXIOMATIC-SSP
fullName: Safety and Efficacy of Factor XIa Inhibition with Milvexian for Secondary Stroke Prevention
population: n=2366, ≥40 years, NIHSS ≤7 (initially ≤5), randomized within 48 h of symptom onset of acute ischaemic stroke or high-risk TIA (age ≥40); 90-day treatment period
finding: Neutral prespecified dose-response analysis. Reported 16.8% placebo and 15.3–16.7% active-arm risks are model-based estimates, not raw event proportions.
teachingPoint: Phase 2 dose-finding evidence; no established clinical benefit. Interpret exploratory stroke and dose-specific bleeding findings separately from the neutral primary analysis.
